configure_model_options: set cfg.MODEL.TYPE, cfg.MODEL.DEPTH, and cfg.MODEL.NUM_CLASSES to configure the neural network model architecture
configure_resnet_options: set cfg.RESNET.NUM_GROUPS and cfg.RESNET.WIDTH_PER_GROUP to switch between ResNet and ResNeXt variants
configure_efficientnet_options: set cfg.EFFICIENT_NET.DEPTHS, cfg.EFFICIENT_NET.WIDTHS, and cfg.EFFICIENT_NET.STRIDES to define EfficientNet stage parameters
configure_rgraph_options: set cfg.RGRAPH.DIM_LIST, cfg.RGRAPH.GROUP_NUM, and cfg.RGRAPH.MESSAGE_TYPE to configure relational graph neural network options
assert_cfg: call assert_cfg() to validate config invariants like batch size divisibility and supported train/test splits
